summary: Find semantic Digche replacements for functional UI icons and retrieve the selected SVG style.

toolsPreview.name: search_icons
toolsPreview.description: Search published Digche icons by name, alias, use case, tag, category, or functional meaning. Use this before choosing a UI icon.

toolsPreview.name: find_replacement
toolsPreview.description: Find and rank Digche replacements for an icon from Lucide, Heroicons, Material Symbols, Font Awesome, or another library. Include the UI context for a more useful match.

toolsPreview.name: get_icon_svg
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve a validated SVG variant after selecting a Digche slug. Prefer Linear for functional product UI unless the project uses another Digche style.
